notes: Heilongjiang Beidahuang Agriculture Co Ltd (SSE: 600598) — listed subsidiary of state-owned Beidahuang Agricultural Reclamation Group. Operates ~12.96 million mu (~865,000 hectares ≈ 2,135K acres) of state-leased cultivated land in Heilongjiang's Sanjiang Plain (one of the world's three black-soil belts). Primary revenue stream is land-contracting fees (subleasing state farmland to cooperative farmers) plus rice, corn, soybean trading. Reports CNY-millions PRC GAAP. Lists in CNY on Shanghai Stock Exchange. Listed since March 2002. Historically very low debt — pure land-rental operating model with minimal capex. FY2020 detailed data not consistently available across English aggregators, so the 5-year history begins in FY2021. acresK figure (~2,135) reflects total operated/contracted area, not freehold ownership.

periods.notes: FY21: Revenue RMB3.63bn (mostly land-contracting fees + grain trading). EBITDA RMB1.34bn (margin 37%). NI RMB770M. Essentially debt-free with RMB1.69bn cash — net cash position of ~RMB1.68bn.
FY22: Revenue RMB4.26bn (+17%). EBITDA RMB1.24bn (margin 29%) — slight compression on input costs. NI RMB975M (+27%). Cash build to RMB3.05bn, net cash RMB3.0bn.
FY23: Revenue RMB5.04bn (+18%). EBITDA RMB1.30bn (margin 26%). NI RMB1.06bn (+9%). Special dividend distributed; cash drew to RMB2.37bn but still net cash.

FY24: Revenue RMB5.34bn (+5.83%). EBITDA RMB1.34bn (margin 25%). NI RMB1.087bn (+2.21%). DPS RMB0.44 — consistent grower. Total assets RMB8.98bn. Land-contracting model = stable annuity-like cash flows.

FY25 (preliminary): Revenue RMB5.23bn (~-2% YoY). DPS lifted to RMB0.55 (+25% YoY) signalling balance-sheet capacity / payout policy review. Full earnings detail pending — only top-line + dividend disclosed.
